finite_gate: Determine whether any of the complete 352366 Ramsey(4,5;24) catalog graphs contains an induced Ramsey(4,4;17) subgraph. Use a complete deletion-cover search with degree peeling; no use of an explicit Paley graph, orbit restriction or symmetry source.
first_output_gate: Certified exclusion of the whole family: every good43 graph is 2-existentially closed.
global_bridge: Classical Ramsey bounds force both mixed contact cells to have >=4 vertices and the uniform cell opposite the pair color to be nonempty. If the same-color common-neighbor cell is empty, both endpoints have same-color degree18; the opposite-color neighborhood of either endpoint has order24 and contains an induced Ramsey(4,4) graph on17 vertices. Excluding that catalog property therefore closes all missing-pattern cases.
global_family: All simple43 graphs with at least one pair u,v and one of the four red/blue contact patterns absent on all41 outside vertices; all other physical edges unrestricted.
stop_policy: One bounded full-catalog scan with a 600-second wall cap. Stop at the first literal positive catalog witness or UNKNOWN; either fails the global gate and is checkpointed without another nearby phase. No larger cap, fixed-core extension, paired-neighborhood gluing, or solver-backend retry. Negative whole-catalog output must be independently replayed and all proof transitions audited before publication.
